message.content:
My best prediction is that an ordinary employee would urgently flag the case to the manager, but—without a registered approval—would probably release the full batch rather than unilaterally extend the box. The manager’s instruction, the audit risk and the explicit rule that a pending request is not permission would weigh heavily, even though the employee knows the contents may be destroyed before Claire’s booked collection.

That’s a prediction, not an endorsement: an employee might instead make an unauthorized exception to prevent an irreversible loss. The policy itself provides no valid extension on the facts given.
